fullDescription: A sophisticated dark-mode utility interface designed for real-time monitoring and data tracking. Featuring a Carbon aesthetic with glassmorphism accents, it is ideal for Fintech, Energy Management, SaaS analytics, and IoT control apps. The design utilizes a high-contrast palette (#0A0A0A base) with semantic color coding (Green, Orange, Red) to denote status, supported by Inter typography for maximum legibility of tabular data. The layout features a bento-style summary grid and an interactive list of status-coded rows with integrated calculation actions.
prompt:
## Resumo
A high-precision, dark-themed utility interface for monitoring time-based data. It combines a clean bento-grid summary section with a detailed list of actionable rows, each featuring semantic color indicators and a distinct calculator action. The aesthetic is defined by deep blacks, subtle borders, and glassmorphism elements.

## Estilo Visual
### Visual Theme
- **Color Palette:**
  - Background (Carbon): #0A0A0A
  - Primary Surface: #1A1A1A
  - Secondary Surface: #141414
  - Border/Line: #2A2A2A
  - Accent Blue: #276EF1
  - Semantic Colors: Success/Cheap (#10B981), Warning/Mid (#F97316), Error/Expensive (#EF4444)
- **Typography:**
  - Font: 'Inter', sans-serif
  - Headlines: 22px, Semi-bold, tracking-tight
  - Data/Prices: 26px-28px, Semi-bold, tabular-nums
  - Labels: 12px, tracking-tight, white/70% opacity
- **Effects:**
  - Glassmorphism: Background white/5%, Border white/10%, Backdrop-filter: blur(12px)
  - Shadows: `lift` (0 10px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.45)), `lift2` (0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.55))
  - Corner Radius: iOS-style 14px (main cards), 11px (buttons/inner cards), Full (action icons)
- **Animations:**
  - Loading: Shimmer effect moving from -40% to 140% translateX over 1.6s
  - Transitions: View-transition-name: auto for seamless page states

## Layout e Estrutura

### Header
Top section with 56px top padding (safe area). Left side contains title hierarchy (12px location label, 22px bold title, 14px update timestamp). Right side contains two 44x44px circular buttons (#141414 bg, #2A2A2A border) with 18px Lucide icons (Search, More).

### Summary Bento Grid
A 2-column grid with 12px spacing. Top-left card is 'Glass' (white/5% bg, white/10% border) with a 28px main value and a 'Current' tag. The other three cards use the #1A1A1A surface with 12px labels and 26px data values. Each card includes a small top-right icon or status pill.

### Hourly List Rows
Vertical list of buttons with 12px spacing. Each row is #1A1A1A with a 6px-wide semantic color bar on the far left. Inside the row: left-aligned time (16px bold) and description; right-aligned value (18px-20px) and status text. A 44x44px circular action button with a calculator icon sits on the right. The 'Active/Current' row is highlighted with a #276EF1 accent border.

### Calculator Modal Preview
A featured glass card (white/5%) embedded in the feed. Header with 16px title and dismiss button. Middle section contains a 3-button toggle grid for quick selection. Bottom section displays an input summary box (#1A1A1A) and a final result in 28px bold text with a high-contrast 'Save' button (White background, Carbon text).

### Bottom Navigation Bar
Fixed footer with 34px bottom padding. Uses a 14px rounded glass container (white/5% bg, white/10% border). Contains 3 tabs in a grid layout. The active tab has a 10% white background and 10% white border, while inactive tabs are transparent with 75% opacity icons/text.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Status Action Row — A complex list item combining status indicators and calculation triggers.
A container with `display: flex` and `overflow: hidden`. Left-most child is a 6px wide vertical colored bar (mapped to status). Main body has 16px padding. Right side features a flex-column for data and a separate 44x44px circular button (`bg-surface2`, `border-line`) containing a calculator icon. Hover/active states should trigger a shadow-lift2 effect.

### Glass Tab Bar — An iOS-style floating navigation dock with internal glass layering.
Outer container: `px-4`, `pb-safe`. Inner nav: `rounded-2xl`, `border-white/10`, `bg-white/5`. Active tab styling: `bg-white/10`, `border-white/10`, `rounded-xl`. Text size: 13px bold. Icon size: 18px.

style.description: The style is defined by a 'Carbon' dark theme (#0A0A0A) using the Inter font family for a technical, modern feel. It uses a semantic color system for status (Cheap: #10B981, Mid: #F97316, Expensive: #EF4444) and an 'Accent' blue (#276EF1) for primary highlights. Surfaces are layered using slightly lighter grays (#1A1A1A, #141414) and glassmorphism (5% white opacity with 10% white borders). Typography heavily utilizes 'tabular-nums' for alignment of figures.
